patch_description:
The current candidate uses 24 trainable parameters per block (146 total), Adam with learning rate 0.03, batches of 15, 30 steps per epoch, validation-loss selection, and patience 75. Its asymmetric omission of the post-RY gate on qubit 3 and the isolated trainable CRZ increase overfitting: train accuracy reaches 0.97 while test accuracy falls to 0.84.

The new block restores a complete post-RY layer and removes the CRZ bottleneck. It replaces the nearest-neighbor CZ line with a connected next-nearest-neighbor schedule: two skip chains are coupled by the final 6–7 edge. This allows phase-map information to move between less-local qubits while retaining seven fixed entanglers and the same 24 parameters per block. Fixed CZ gates avoid adding parameter variance, while balanced rotations on every measured qubit should reduce the train-test gap and recover the stronger validation/test behavior of the prior symmetric blocks.
